examInfo.title: Rajasthan High Court System Assistant Examination
examInfo.ruleDiscrepancy: In case of language ambiguity, English version prevails

lessons.title: Tenses Architecture & Time Markers
lessons.description: Master all 12 tense structures (3 Times × 4 Aspects), auxiliary verb rules, affirmative/negative/interrogative patterns, and deterministic time markers.
learningObjectives: Deconstruct the dual-axis tense matrix (Time × Aspect)
Master structural formulas and auxiliary verbs for all 12 tenses
Identify deterministic time markers that signal correct tense choice
Disambiguate Simple Past vs Present Perfect and other confusing pairs
Construct positive, negative, and interrogative sentences accurately

lessons.title: Sequence of Tenses & Tense Harmony
lessons.description: Rules governing tense agreement between main and subordinate clauses, past tense harmony, and universal truth exceptions.

lessons.title: Conditional Sentences & Future Time Clauses
lessons.description: Types 0, 1, 2, 3 conditionals, inverted conditionals (Had I..., Were he...), and temporal conjunction constraints.

lessons.title: Active & Passive Voice Fundamentals
lessons.description: Core active-to-passive conversions across tenses, auxiliary expansion (be + V3), and untransformable tenses.

lessons.title: Advanced Voice: Imperatives, Modals & Prepositional Verbs
lessons.description: Imperative passives (Let + obj + be + V3), modals (modal + be + V3), and retained fixed prepositions in passive voice.

lessons.title: Direct & Indirect Speech Fundamentals
lessons.description: Reporting verbs, backshift of tenses, pronoun reference shifts (SON rule), and adverbial time/place adjustments.

lessons.title: Advanced Narration: Interrogatives, Imperatives & Exclamatory
lessons.description: Yes/No (if/whether) and Wh- questions, question inversion removal, imperative commands/requests, and exclamations.

lessons.title: Sentence Transformations: Polarity & Types
lessons.description: Assertive to Negative without meaning change, Interrogative transformations, and Exclamatory conversions.

lessons.title: Degrees of Comparison & Clause Transformations
lessons.description: Positive, Comparative ('any other' + singular noun), Superlative degrees, and 'Too...to' to 'So...that' conversions.

topics.title: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions

lessons.title: Articles: A/An Phonetics, The & Zero Article Omission
lessons.description: Vocalic sound rules for A/An, definite article The in legal contexts, omission of articles and particularization exceptions.

lessons.title: Determiners & Quantifiers: Little vs Few Architecture
lessons.description: Countable vs uncountable quantifiers (Little/A little/The little vs Few/A few/The few), Each/Every distinctions.

lessons.title: Prepositions: Spatio-Temporal & Administrative Fixed Prepositions
lessons.description: In/At/On hierarchies, transitive verbs taking no preposition, and 50+ high-frequency administrative fixed prepositions.

lessons.title: Subject-Verb Agreement & Error Architecture
lessons.description: Proximity rule (Either/or), First-subject rule (as well as), distributive pronouns ('One of the' + plural noun + singular verb), collective nouns.

lessons.title: Connectives, Modifiers & Words Wrongly Used Table
lessons.description: Correlative conjunctions (Scarcely...when, No sooner...than, Lest...should), confusing word pairs (Affect/Effect, Judicial/Judicious).

lessons.title: High-Frequency & Legal/Administrative Synonyms & Antonyms
lessons.description: 100+ high-frequency vocabulary words with legal, administrative, and competitive exam contextual sentences.

lessons.title: One-Word Substitutions (Root Words & Court Terms)
lessons.description: High-yield one-word substitutions with focus on legal, judicial, administrative, and morphological roots.

lessons.title: Prefixes & Suffixes: Morphological Word Formation
lessons.description: Affixes modifying roots, legal/administrative prefixes (Juris-, Non-, Ir-, Mal-), suffixes creating nouns, adjectives, verbs.

lessons.title: Idioms & Phrases in Administrative & Judicial Contexts
lessons.description: 50+ recurring idioms in High Court and Rajasthan exams (At the eleventh hour, Null and void, In black and white).
